Ann must be in slot 2 and Ben in slot 1, which forces the rest. Ann can't be in 1 or 4. Ben can't be in 5 or 6, so Ann can't be in 6 or 7 (Ben would be directly before her in 5 or 6). Ann in 5 puts Elif in 1 or 2, but Elif must come right after Dev, so Elif can't be that early. Ann in 3 forces Cara into slot 1, which is before Ann. That leaves Ann in 2, Ben in 1.

With Ann in 2, Elif must be at least 3 away, so Elif is in 5 or 7 (not 6). Dev–Elif is a consecutive block with Finn before Dev. Elif in 5 fails because Gus would have to be before Finn in slots 6–7. So Elif is in 7, Dev in 6, Finn in 5. Cara can't be in 4, so Cara is in 3 and Gus in 4. That satisfies Gus before Finn, and Ben–Dev are 5 apart.

Checked all 16 constraints against this arrangement; they hold.
